article.title: Shackled and defiant, Maduro and Flores reject new bogus charges
article.author: Editor
article.content: Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro Moros and First Combatant Cilia Adela Flores were brought to a federal court in Manhattan this morning shackled and defiant. Facing Judge Alvin Hellerstein, both prisoners of war were arraigned on phony charges of torture. The post Shackled and defiant, Maduro and Flores reject new bogus charges appeared first on MR Online .
